mapper.sql: c.id, c.user_id, c.name, c.cover_url, c.visibility, c.created_at, c.updated_at

FROM saved_categories c LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS item_count, MAX(sp.created_at) AS last_saved_at FROM saved_places sp WHERE sp.user_id = c.user_id AND sp.category IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(BTRIM(sp.category)) = LOWER(BTRIM(c.name)) ) stats ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT sp.photo_url FROM saved_places sp WHERE sp.user_id = c.user_id AND sp.category IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(BTRIM(sp.category)) = LOWER(BTRIM(c.name)) AND sp.photo_url IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM(sp.photo_url) <> '' ORDER BY sp.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, sp.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) photo ON TRUE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO saved_categories (id, user_id, name, visibility, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, BTRIM(#{name}), 'PRIVATE', #{now}, #{now}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM saved_categories c WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND LOWER(BTRIM(c.name)) = LOWER(BTRIM(#{name}))
